Standard: Procedures for the handling, release and control, loading, and maintenance of armament systems and stores are defined and prevent damage to the air vehicle during loading, operation, or delivery of stores. This includes any individual store or air vehicle installation manuals and electronic tools that dictate how stores are installed and removed from the air vehicle under any operational condition. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Examination.
(1) Verify that procedures for release and control and loading and unloading the store are available prior to loading non-inert stores or powering on the air vehicle.
(2) Verify that all safety and emergency procedures associated with handling, loading and downloading, and emergency disposal are technically accurate, meet all operating environment restrictions, and have been provided to the test team.
(3) Verify all loadout configurations to ensure there are no unique and undocumented loading sequences that need to be adhered to prevent unsafe loading, specifically associated to ordnance or energetics. Prior to entering operational test/operations, verify the standard by the above and following method(s): Examination.
(4) Verify that applicable release and control and store loading and unloading procedures have been verified by the appropriate technical authority and are documented in USG verified technical documents or equivalent supplement(s).
(5) Verify that all electronic tools supporting store loading procedures are verified and comply with the USG verified technical documents.
